name: Livia Zaharia / ParalDesign
summary: Livia develops digitally designed, printed and cast jewelry around natural materials. Open silver settings expose and protect irregular stones; biological forms become geometry and practical structure. Livistone extends selected jewelry into buildings and landscapes.
experiment_note: These are new AI-generated concept studies made from her reference photographs. The acoustic mappings and proposed buildings are this experiment's choices. Outputs are images, not validated wearable objects or fabrication meshes.

references.title: Nanot of Power · sterling silver
references.connection: Digitally designed open silver lattice. Livistone enlarges its lattice into the Ministry of Science.

references.title: Mitoring · amber and sterling silver
references.connection: An irregular amber core held by folded silver. Livistone interprets these folds as mitochondrial cristae and enlarges them into the Ministry of Energy.

references.title: Mycelium · opal and sterling silver
references.connection: Livia's stated problem was drainage around porous opal. The open fungal-inspired setting becomes a rain garden in Livistone.

references.title: Livistone · jewelry at architectural scale
references.connection: Mitoring's amber hall, Nut of Power's walnut city hall and Nanot's silver lattice science hall. This is a rendered town scene, not a photograph of a built place.
